one_liner: Telegram offers Bot API, TDLib, and Gateway APIs for messaging, auth, and custom clients.
gating_notes: Bot API requires creating a bot via @BotFather (free). Gateway API requires funding an account for production, but offers free testing messages to the linked account. TDLib requires an application identifier.
oauth_details: Telegram supports OpenID Connect (OIDC) with Authorization Code Flow and PKCE for user login. Bot API uses a static token. Gateway API uses a Bearer token.

auth_methods.quote: In this guide, we’ll assume you decided to use a _bearer token_.

primary_auth.quote: In this guide, we’ll assume you decided to use a _bearer token_.

credential_access.quote: For testing purposes, you’ll be able to send free verification messages to the Telegram account tied to the number you used to log in.

api_breadth.quote: Added the method setMySettings, allowing bots to change their settings, including inline mode settings, privacy mode, the ability to be added to groups, forum topic mode in private chats, and the mode of receiving callback queries.
